ca43e2ee8c15ee.s: Who became the first Indian Chairman of the Public Service Commission in 1947?
ca43e2ee8c15ee.x: H.K. Kripalani became the first Indian Chairman in 1947; 1937 is when the Federal PSC name came into use.

ca82c8ec89d386.s: Which Article empowers Parliament to restrict the Fundamental Rights of members of the armed forces?
ca82c8ec89d386.x: Article 33 lets Parliament restrict Fundamental Rights of members of the forces. The Assam Rifles is administratively under MHA and operationally under the Army.

caf5d14dab788f.s: Under the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026, technical guidance is provided by:
caf5d14dab788f.x: CSIR-NPL provides technical guidance while the Legal Metrology Department enforces the Rules; other time zones may be shown only along with IST.

cabc4715cf9e6d.s: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Act, 2026 received Presidential assent on:
cabc4715cf9e6d.x: Assent came on 6 August 2026; the Act extends anthem-level protection to Vande Mataram.

ca31c858b05d3f.s: Article 44, which deals with the Uniform Civil Code, is placed in which Part of the Constitution?
ca31c858b05d3f.x: Article 44 is a Directive Principle in Part IV. The Gujarat UCC Bill-2026 also covers live-in relationships.

cae74ccad5fb4c.s: PRAHAAR, India's counter-terrorism policy, was unveiled by Amit Shah on:
cae74ccad5fb4c.x: PRAHAAR, a 10-year framework, was unveiled on 23 February 2026; its conference was held in New Delhi, not Mumbai.

cab5203419d3db.s: For remand, written grounds of arrest must be supplied at least how long before production?
cab5203419d3db.x: The ruling requires written grounds at least 2 hours before production for remand, else the arrest is illegal; Section 47 BNSS also covers grounds and bail rights.

ca767910ac0eaf.s: Under Paragraph 6 of the Tenth Schedule, disqualification on grounds of defection is decided by the:
ca767910ac0eaf.x: Paragraph 6 gives the decision to the Speaker, subject to judicial review; Article 192 (Governor) concerns other disqualifications.

ca544fccbadaf8.s: Which time-dissemination technology offers microsecond accuracy?
ca544fccbadaf8.x: PTP gives microseconds; NTP gives milliseconds, satellite links nanoseconds and optical links picoseconds.

cnafc12a1ab0f2.s: Under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007, a senior citizen is a person aged:
cnafc12a1ab0f2.x: The 2007 Act defines a senior citizen as a person aged 60 or above. The International Day of Older Persons is 1 October.

cnf3b757d29f0b.s: Under the CAFE-III norms, what incentive multiplier do strong hybrids get?
cnf3b757d29f0b.x: Strong hybrids get 1.6x; BEVs and REEVs get 3x and PHEVs 2.5x.

cn5538004f5d70.s: The draft FSSAI infant nutrition amendment (2026) proposes prohibiting sucrose and fructose in foods for infants under:
cn5538004f5d70.x: The draft, gazetted on 16 October 2026, covers foods for infants under six months; FSSAI is under the Health Ministry.

cnc3d51c3dea0f.s: Which Constitutional Amendment lowered the voting age from 21 to 18?
cnc3d51c3dea0f.x: The 61st Amendment, 1988 lowered the voting age to 18. Article 324 gives the ECI control over electoral rolls.

cn5674356d4a32.s: The Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) is under which Ministry?

cn5674356d4a32.x: DARPG is under the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions. Digital India was launched on 1 July 2015.

cndd0f7d66143f.s: In which year was the National e-Governance Plan (NeGP) approved?
cndd0f7d66143f.x: NeGP was approved in 2006; Digital India came in 2015 and Himachal Pradesh became a State in 1971.

cna8b929a4fc56.s: The National Disaster Response Force (NDRF) was established in:
cna8b929a4fc56.x: The NDRF was established in 2006 under the Disaster Management Act, 2005.

cn4467c2ab56eb.s: El Niño, the warm phase of ENSO, involves above-normal sea surface temperatures in the:
cn4467c2ab56eb.x: El Niño brings above-normal SST in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific and is often linked to a weaker southwest monsoon.

cn9b6e0b824589.s: In the KG-D6 block, Reliance holds what share?
cn9b6e0b824589.x: Reliance holds 60%, BP 30% and Niko 10%. The 2016 demand notice was for $1.47 billion.

cn098f4a2e61e3.s: The Arbitration and Conciliation Act, relevant to the KG Basin gas dispute, was enacted in:
cn098f4a2e61e3.x: The Act is of 1996; 1956 is when ONGC was established.

cn9d97d7b63fde.s: The 2026 Telangana ordinance raising judicial officers' retirement age was promulgated by the Governor under:
cn9d97d7b63fde.x: Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla promulgated it under Article 213(1), retrospective from 31 March 2026; Article 123 is the President's power.

cnc027cfa414f4.s: Under Article 124, Supreme Court judges retire at the age of:
cnc027cfa414f4.x: Supreme Court judges retire at 65; High Court judges retire at 62 under Article 217.

cn59801dd539d7.s: The Conference of PAC Chairpersons in November 2026 was inaugurated in:
cn59801dd539d7.x: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla inaugurated it in Thiruvananthapuram. Union Ministers cannot be PAC members.

cn3395bcffc794.s: In Delhi-NCR, green crackers are banned within what distance of hospitals and silence zones?
cn3395bcffc794.x: The ban applies within 300 m of hospitals, nursing homes, old-age homes and silence zones; barium-based crackers are prohibited.

cn20adf9f04865.s: Bihar's Silt Management Policy-2026, the first such State policy, was approved on:
cn20adf9f04865.x: It was approved on 15 September and announced by CM Samrat Choudhary on 3 November 2026. The Kosi is the 'Sorrow of Bihar'.

cne5c0c63a8c6c.s: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam-2026 is framed under the:
cne5c0c63a8c6c.x: It is framed under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 and comes into force on 1 January 2027.

ca4b3d07555cfe.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment, 2026?
o: Article 124(1) lets Parliament fix the number of judges by law
It raised puisne judges from 33 to 36
Total strength including the CJI became 38
It amends the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1956
ca4b3d07555cfe.x: Puisne judges were raised from 33 to 37, not 36; total strength including the CJI is 38.

ca75a5b3cb46fa.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Act, 2026?
o: Special fast-track courts must finish trials within 2 months
The probe must be completed within 60 days
It is administered by the Ministry of Home Affairs
ca75a5b3cb46fa.x: The Act is administered by the Ministry of Personnel, not MHA.

ca7cfe4e41b269.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the FCRA?
o: Journalists are barred from receiving foreign contribution
Foreign contribution may be transferred to other NGOs
Administrative expenses are capped at 20% of annual FC
ca7cfe4e41b269.x: Funds received in the designated SBI account cannot be transferred to other NGOs.

cae4cd60a83a09.s: Under the 2026 FCRA changes, probes by State agencies require prior approval of the:
cae4cd60a83a09.x: State agencies need Central approval before FCRA probes; revision and appeal lie to the District Judge.

ca55a1c1fe7d49.s: Under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Rules, 2026, registration is tied to a Schedule of how many permissible purposes?
ca55a1c1fe7d49.x: Registration is tied to a Schedule of 105 permissible purposes; proselytisation is excluded from permitted religious activities.

cac7ce1552a183.s: Under the BNSS, no person may be detained without being produced before a magistrate beyond:
cac7ce1552a183.x: Detention beyond 24 hours without production before a magistrate is barred; total police custody is capped at 15 days.

ca6bf79ee960a0.s: Under Section 187(3) of the BNSS, detention in cases punishable with death, life or 10+ years may extend up to how many days before default bail?
ca6bf79ee960a0.x: Detention may extend to 90 days in such cases and 60 days in others, after which default bail follows.

caf116b9a8f15c.s: Which Ministry implements the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023?
caf116b9a8f15c.x: MeitY implements the DPDP Act, 2023; the Right to be Forgotten is treated as part of privacy under Article 21.

caf8aebd898a1f.s: Which Article gives an arrested person the right to consult and be defended by a legal practitioner of choice?
caf8aebd898a1f.x: Article 22(1) guarantees counsel of choice; Article 21 includes a fair trial within the right to life.

ca2b63584055b5.s: The right to be forgotten is linked to informational privacy under which Article?
ca2b63584055b5.x: It flows from informational privacy under Article 21; the DPDP Act's erasure right is unclear for court records.

ca3516c4289950.s: Which High Court held in 2023 that the right to be forgotten is not automatic for ongoing proceedings?
ca3516c4289950.x: The Kerala High Court (2023) held so; the Supreme Court (2022) had a couple's details removed from search engines.

n4bca4ea435d.s: In ADR v. ECI, the Supreme Court held that exclusion of a name from the electoral roll:
o: Is not a declaration of non-citizenship
Needs prior approval of the Supreme Court
Ends the ECI's power to examine citizenship
n4bca4ea435d.x: The ECI may examine citizenship during revision, but exclusion from the roll is not a declaration of non-citizenship.

cafc8e05918526.s: According to the August 2026 update, how many districts are officially classified as LWE-affected?
cafc8e05918526.x: India was reported effectively free from LWE, with no district officially listed as LWE-affected.

ca9921bba1a371.x: The official six-stanza version runs 3 minutes 10 seconds; Jana Gana Mana runs 52 seconds.

new.x: The Joint Parliamentary Committee on the ONOE Bill is chaired by P.P. Chaudhary.

new.s: One Nation One Election is proposed through which Constitution Amendment Bill?
new.x: The Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 provides for simultaneous elections.

new.s: Who won the Nagaon (Assam) Lok Sabha by-election counted on 9 October 2026?
new.x: BJP's Debasish Sharma beat AIUDF chief Badruddin Ajmal; the seat fell vacant when Pradyut Bordoloi won Dispur.

new.s: Which party won both Tamil Nadu Assembly by-elections (Madurantakam and Dharapuram) in October 2026?
new.x: The ruling TVK won both Madurantakam and Dharapuram.

new.s: The Thattanchavady (Puducherry) Assembly seat fell vacant on the resignation of:
new.x: It fell vacant when CM N. Rangasamy resigned; AINRC's Ashok Anand won the by-election.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the by-elections of October 2026:
1. The BJP won both West Bengal Assembly seats.
2. Nagaon in Assam is an Assembly seat.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only 1 is correct: the BJP won Nandigram and Rejinagar. Nagaon is a Lok Sabha seat.

new.s: The Kerala (Alteration of Name) Act, 2026, renaming Kerala as Keralam, came into force on:
new.x: It came into force on 25 August 2026 by MHA notification; Rajya Sabha passed it on 12 August.

new.s: On 2 October 2026, MHA standardised the names of how many places and features in Ladakh?
new.x: 28 places and geographical features in Ladakh were given standard names on the Survey of India map.

new.s: Which country called the standardisation of place names in Ladakh 'illegal and void'?
new.x: China called it illegal and void; the MEA rejected the claim.

new.s: Under Section 115BB, winnings from lotteries are taxed at:
new.x: Winnings are taxed at 30% under Section 115BB; 40% is the GST rate on lotteries.

new.s: From 22 September 2025, GST on lotteries, betting, casinos and online money gaming is:
new.x: These attract 40% GST from 22 September 2025.

new.s: According to a Lok Sabha reply of March 2023, how many States run lotteries?
new.x: Nine States run lotteries, including Kerala, Goa, Punjab, Sikkim and West Bengal.

new.s: Which case laid down the 'all-or-nothing' rule on lotteries?
new.x: B.R. Enterprises (1999) gave the all-or-nothing rule, after which Tamil Nadu and Karnataka went lottery-free.

new.s: Lotteries organised by the Union or State governments fall under:
new.x: Union List Entry 40 covers government lotteries; betting and gambling are State List Entry 34.

new.s: An ordinance ceases to operate, unless approved, after how long from the reassembly of Parliament?
new.x: An ordinance lapses six weeks after Parliament reassembles unless approved.

new.s: Which case held that repeated re-promulgation of ordinances is unconstitutional?
o: Krishna Kumar Singh v. State of Bihar (2017)
D.C. Wadhwa v. State of Bihar (1986)
Bijoe Emmanuel v. State of Kerala (1986)
new.x: D.C. Wadhwa (1986) struck at repeated re-promulgation; Krishna Kumar Singh (2017) held an ordinance is not a substitute for legislation.

new.s: The SC Advocates-on-Record Association case (2015) struck down the NJAC Act and the:
new.x: The 2015 judgment struck down the 99th Amendment and the NJAC Act.

new.s: The Law Commission recommended how many judges per million population?
new.x: The Law Commission recommended 50 judges per million, against about 15.9 per the India Justice Report 2025.

new.s: About how many cases were pending in the Supreme Court on 1 January 2026?
new.x: SC pendency was about 92,101; in 2025, 75,410 cases were filed and 65,615 disposed of.

new.s: The 'Triple Test' for defining 'industry' was laid down in:
o: Bangalore Water Supply v. A. Rajappa (1978)
new.x: The 7-judge bench of Justice V.R. Krishna Iyer laid down the Triple Test in Bangalore Water Supply (1978).

new.s: The August 2026 Supreme Court ruling refining the definition of 'industry' was delivered by a bench of:
new.x: A 9-judge Constitution Bench led by CJI Surya Kant ruled 6:3; the 1978 ruling was by 7 judges.

new.s: Which case held that any creamy-layer exclusion among Scheduled Castes must come from Parliament?
new.x: E.V. Chinnaiah (2005) held so; Ashoka Kumar Thakur said the creamy layer does not apply to SC/STs.

new.s: Justice Sachin Datta's guidelines let search engines delist judgments mainly for:
o: Acquitted persons, private civil disputes and non-parties
new.x: Delisting is mainly for acquitted persons, private civil disputes and non-parties.

new.s: Which case held privacy to be a fundamental right, including informational privacy?
o: K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017)
new.x: Puttaswamy (2017) made privacy a fundamental right; Rajagopal (1994) spoke of the right to be let alone.

new.s: In European law (GDPR), the right to be forgotten is called the right to:
new.x: European law calls it the right to erasure; India's DPDP Act, 2023 also recognises erasure.

new.s: Women made up what share of the 8,360 candidates in the 2024 Lok Sabha election?
new.x: Women were 9.6% of candidates in the 2024 Lok Sabha polls; 9.7% was the AP Assembly 2024 share.

new.s: According to ADR, which State had the highest share of women candidates?
new.x: Odisha led with 13.9%, followed by Delhi (13.7%) and Puducherry (13.6%).

new.s: The 33% reservation under the Women's Reservation Act, 2023 takes effect after:
new.x: The 33% quota in Lok Sabha and Assemblies applies after the next Census and delimitation.

new.s: In Assam, 'doubtful voters' marked in the 1997 revision were referred to:
new.x: D-voters from the 1997 revision were referred to Foreigners Tribunals.

new.s: Under Section 3A of the 1971 National Honour Act (added in 2003), a repeat offence attracts a minimum of:
new.x: Section 3A prescribes at least 1 year for a repeat offence; the general penalty is up to 3 years.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Act, 2026?
o: It amends Section 3 of the 1971 Act
It makes singing Vande Mataram compulsory
It punishes intentional disturbance of singing the National Song
It was introduced in the Rajya Sabha
new.x: The Act does not make singing compulsory or punish respectful silence.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Song:
1. The Constitution mentions a 'National Song'.
2. Vande Mataram was given equal honour with Jana Gana Mana on 24 January 1950.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only 2 is correct: Rajendra Prasad accorded equal honour on 24 January 1950. The Constitution does not mention a National Song.

new.s: Vande Mataram was first published in Bangadarshan on:
new.x: It appeared in Bangadarshan on 7 November 1875 and later in Anandamath (1882); 7 August 1905 was its Swadeshi use.

new.s: Under the 2026 Public Examinations amendment, an erring service provider can be debarred for:
new.x: Debarment rises to 8 years (from 4), with a fine up to ₹5 crore (from ₹1 crore).

new.s: How many Fast Track Courts were functioning as of August 2026?
new.x: There are 884 FTCs in 21 States/UTs, with 17.54 lakh pending cases; FTCs began in 2000.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the FCRA (Amendment) Rules, 2026:
1. Proselytisation is excluded from permitted religious activities.
2. Existing NGOs must file Form FC-6F within one year.
3. The annual return is filed in Form FC-6F.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The annual return is filed in Form FC-4.

new.s: The first Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act was enacted in:
new.x: The first FCRA came in 1976; registration became mandatory in 1984 and it was replaced by FCRA 2010.

new.s: Under the IST Rules, 2026, time displays at railway stations, airports and government offices must show:
new.x: Display in hh:mm:ss (not hh:mm) is mandatory at such places.

new.s: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 is administered by the Ministry of:
new.x: The Legal Metrology Act, 2009 falls under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the renaming of Kerala as Keralam:
1. The Bill was passed by the Lok Sabha before the Rajya Sabha.
2. The name of the Kerala High Court was also changed.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Only 1 is correct: Lok Sabha passed it on 11 August and Rajya Sabha on 12 August. The High Court's name is unchanged.

new.s: Which court issued a non-bailable warrant against Hafiz Saeed in the Pahalgam attack case?
new.x: The Special NIA Court, Jammu issued the warrant; the NIA may seek trial in absentia under Section 356 BNSS.

new.s: Before trial in absentia, the BNSS requires two consecutive arrest warrants issued at least how many days apart?
new.x: Two consecutive warrants at least 30 days apart are required.

new.s: Trial in absentia under Section 356 of the BNSS may begin only after how many days from framing of charges?
new.x: Trial can start only after 90 days from framing of charges.

new.s: A proclaimed offender, to whom trial in absentia applies, is declared under which Section of the BNSS?
new.x: Section 84 BNSS covers proclaimed offenders; Sections 82, 299 and 317 are the old CrPC provisions.

new.s: The e-Courts Services App is meant for:
new.x: The e-Courts Services App is for litigants; the JustIS App is for judges.

new.s: How many Virtual Courts for traffic offences were functional in August 2026?
new.x: There were 31 virtual courts in August 2026 (30 in March), handling 11.33 crore challans.

new.s: Phase I of the e-Courts Mission Mode Project (2011-2015) focused on:
new.x: Phase I computerised 14,000+ courts; Phase II brought NJDG and e-Sewa Kendras; Phase III is paperless courts and AI.

new.s: Which e-Courts AI tool is used for translation?
new.x: PANINI translates; LegRAA is for legal research, ASR-SHRUTI is voice to text and NSTEP tracks summons.

new.s: The tenure of Solicitor General Tushar Mehta was extended from 1 July 2026 by:
new.x: His tenure was extended by 3 years from 1 July 2026.

new.s: The Attorney General of India, the highest law officer, is provided for under:
new.x: Article 76 provides for the Attorney General; Article 165 is the Advocate General of a State.

new.s: Sikkim became the 8th member of the North Eastern Council through the NEC (Amendment) Act of:
new.x: The NEC (Amendment) Act, 2002 added Sikkim; the NEC was set up under a 1971 Act.

new.s: The Vice-Chairman of a Zonal Council is:
o: The Governor of the host State
A member-State Chief Minister by annual rotation
new.x: A member-State CM serves as Vice-Chairman by annual rotation; the Union Home Minister chairs.

new.s: Left-Wing Extremist violence peaked with 1,936 incidents in:
new.x: The peak was in 2010; Naxalbari began in 1967 and CPI (Maoist) formed in 2004.

new.s: The National Policy and Action Plan to address LWE was adopted in:
new.x: The 2015 Policy rests on Dialogue, Security and Coordination; the Bastariya Battalion came in 2017.

new.s: In the Saptadhara framework of the 80th Independence Day speech, the fourth pathway is:
o: PM Gati Shakti and multimodal transport
new.x: The fourth pathway is PM Gati Shakti; manufacturing is first, agriculture second and defence fifth.

new.s: The PM announced a talent search among children aged 5-15 aimed at the Olympics of:
new.x: The talent search targets the 2038 Olympics.
